title: StarCraft II 5.0.17 Patch Notes
desc: [News] Based on feedback, we have rolled back most balance changes to the live release of StarCraft II from patch 5.0.16 to 5.0.15.

title: StarCraft II 5.0.17 PTR Patch Notes
desc: [News] New patch is released in PTR, which rolls back the balance changes made in 5.0.16 while retaining the updated map pool and bugfixes.
